vectors.name: fold/different-fields
vectors.description: Two records set different fields of one item: both fields keep their values.

vectors.name: fold/same-field
vectors.description: Same field set twice: the later one wins, the earlier is history.

vectors.name: fold/same-field-reversed-input
vectors.description: The same two records listed in the other order give the same state.

vectors.name: fold/tie-wall-counter-author
vectors.description: Equal wall_ms and counter: the greater author (bytewise) wins.

vectors.name: fold/tie-counter
vectors.description: Equal wall_ms: the greater counter wins even from the smaller author.

vectors.name: fold/clear-after-set
vectors.description: A later clear beats an earlier set: the field is cleared and the value is history.

vectors.name: fold/set-after-clear
vectors.description: A later set beats an earlier clear.

vectors.name: fold/set-and-clear-different-fields-one-record
vectors.description: One record sets one field and clears another.

vectors.name: fold/null-value-vs-clear
vectors.description: A field set to the value null is not the same as a cleared field: the first has current null and cleared false, the second cleared true.

vectors.name: fold/delete-after-edit
vectors.description: deleted later than every other field: the item is in Recently Deleted.

vectors.name: fold/edit-after-delete
vectors.description: An edit later than the delete brings the item back.

vectors.name: fold/clear-after-delete
vectors.description: A later clear of another field also counts as an edit.

vectors.name: fold/delete-in-same-record-as-edit
vectors.description: A record that sets deleted and another field: the other field is not strictly later than deleted (same write position), so the item stays deleted.

vectors.name: fold/delete-tie-with-edit-by-greater-author
vectors.description: An edit with the same wall_ms and counter as the delete but a greater author (and the delete by the smaller) sorts later: strictly later, so the item is back.

vectors.name: fold/delete-tie-with-edit-by-smaller-author
vectors.description: The same, but the edit has the smaller author: it sorts earlier than the delete, so the item stays deleted.

vectors.name: fold/delete-value-plays-no-part
vectors.description: The value of deleted is a time shown to the person and does not decide anything: a later write with a smaller value wins.

vectors.name: fold/clear-deleted-field
vectors.description: Clearing deleted undeletes the item.

vectors.name: fold/delete-twice
vectors.description: Deleted set twice: the later write wins; still deleted.

vectors.name: fold/two-items
vectors.description: Records for two items stay separate.

vectors.name: fold/structured-values
vectors.description: Values are opaque: a map value wins or loses whole.

vectors.name: fold/three-orders-one-state
vectors.description: The same four records folded in three different orders (listed) give one state.

vectors.name: fold/duplicate-record
vectors.description: The same record twice changes nothing.
